# Good-bye meeting. Kuailu Meeting allows for better cross-border collaboration and better communication across borders.

- Publication channel: China Daily News Network (central media)
- Release time: 2025-11-20
- Original link: [https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202511/20/WS691ec5a8a310942cc4992791.html](https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202511/20/WS691ec5a8a310942cc4992791.html]

## Text
In 2025, the cloud conference was not an “option”, but a “just-in-demand tool” for cross-regional collaboration among enterprises.

Just like sales in your team, you have to go online every day to connect clients -- talk about needs, demonstrate programs, keep an eye on the project. However, as the number of clients increases and the demand becomes more complex, it is also necessary to bring together internal teams; together with outreach abroad, meetings with clients in different languages are slowly becoming a burden:

Before we start, we're going to have to go through the information, manage the issues, build the meetings manually, and send the links to people in mainstream social tools, mainstream business platforms, mailing lists, 30 minutes of meetings, one hour of preparation; either we can't communicate in depth, or we can't keep track of the information, we can't keep track of it, we can't catch up with the top, we're always afraid of missing key content; we're going to have a recording, we're going to spend almost 100 hours a month, we're going to spend all day a week, we're going to have to follow up on it; let's not mention that the network is running into “PPT”, or we're worried about the leak of business meetings.

These problems can be solved easily by Kuailu Meeting.

As an AI-based smart meeting system, Kuailu Technology integrates AI and audio and video technology, which provides remote communication collaboration and information management services, such as the core functions of AI conference hosting, AI minutes, human image digital person, conference recording, and somatic recognition, multi-channel voice separation, intelligent search backtracking, which can be covered by daily meetings, remote training or online interviews. It also supports narrow-banded high-resolution video, with public clouds, privatization deployments and adaptation to different business needs.

I. Pre-session time is not required: a word can be used to organize meetings, and an invitation is accurate. Power.

Previously, at the preparatory meeting, you had to go through a collection of materials to keep the subject of the meeting in line, build a meeting in the system manually, and finally send links to participants scattered across mainstream social tools, mainstream corporate office platforms, and telephone addresses. A 30-minute meeting could take one hour to prepare alone, particularly affecting efficiency.

Now, using Kuailu Meeting, you can just talk to the system and ask for it, without manually filling in any meeting information, and AI will automatically set up your meetings and give you notice. It also supported real-time transitions in Chinese and English where overseas colleagues or clients were present, pre-communications would not be carded and preparatory efficiency would be raised directly.

II. There is no fear of omission: digital person, AI hosting + real-time translation, full information control

Have you ever had these problems with important meetings? There are several meetings at a senior level, which are so fragmented that other people's representatives are afraid of missing key messages; meetings with overseas clients, who don't know the language, and it's hard enough to think about what they say, can't talk business properly.

Kuailu Meeting offers specific solutions to these problems:

• Allowing companies to customize executive-specific digital or 3D-styles, through ASI face-catching techniques, allowing digital faces to be synchronized with participants in real time, allowing them to participate in meetings without exposing their true identity, protecting executive privacy, matching 3D digital corporate styles, and enhancing brand recognition.

• If there are too many meetings of senior managers or if there are any temporary departures, the AI hosting function can take over the management of the meetings, even if the time is scattered, and many meetings can be easily handled; and the minutes of the meetings during the hosting period can be accurately reviewed by the senior managers, without missing any key information.

• Cross-country communication is much better, as it supports real-time translation in more than a dozen languages, such as Central, British, Thai and Malay. You do not have to focus on translation, focus on the content of meetings, and communicate efficiently.

After the meeting, no effort was made: AI automatically wrote the minutes and the process moved faster.

More operations and more online meetings followed, with many teams meeting almost 100 times a month. It will take at least a full day per week to organize the proceedings into a detailed summary. It is also prone to errors, either missing key messages or a lack of timely follow-up to the conclusions of the meetings, which has a significant impact on progress.

Kuailu Meeting, with its unique conference room voice recognition technology, is able to accurately match each speaker and increase the accuracy of the proceedings by 50 per cent; it is also able to customize the business-specific summary template, which took three hours to write, and is now available in 15 minutes, resulting in faster outcomes and less time for transactional work.

IV. Special needs are met: network stability, security and safety

It is now normal for meetings to be held at any time or place, but the network environment is different from one place to another, and unstable signals affect the effectiveness of meetings. Kuailu Meeting reduces the demand for broadband by optimizing coding technology, and can hold a steady video conference regardless of the network environment; and it supports 1080 P-high-screen, 150 ms low delay, with a 50 per cent passback resistance to shaking, with a clear and stable picture of the entire process and no “PPT”.

If your meeting involves business secrets and concerns about leaking information, Kuailu Meeting ' s privatization deployment function will be useful. The deployment through privatization would ensure the security of meetings and prevent the disclosure of information, and would allow all information generated by the meetings to be owned by enterprises without addressing the issue of attribution of data.

Now online meetings are no longer a tool for simple connectivity, but rather a movement towards "AI, smart, secure, scenery" -- • Business needs to move away from “meetings” to “meetings and transformations” to address both the efficiency of cross-border collaboration and barriers to cross-border communication, and to ensure that information security and results are achieved.

Kuailu Meeting responds to this trend and integrates AI in depth into the whole process: breaking communication barriers with smart grouping, real-time translation, using digital and AI hosting solutions points, accelerating the translation of results with smart records, and ensuring experience and security with a narrow belt of high-level, privatized deployments. It does not just help businesses “to meet efficiently”, it is better able to upgrade through the intellectualization of the entire chain of meetings, making each conference a “productivity tool” for business and enabling decision-making, and truly empowering firms to take the lead in working together.
